definitions.gloss: side of the abdomen; flank; side of the body
definitions.explanation: The area on the side of the torso, between the ribs and the hip.

definitions.gloss: side; flank (of an object or vehicle)
definitions.explanation: The side surface of something, by extension from the body part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{横腹|よこばら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}く→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My side hurts when I run.

examples.japanese: {横腹|よこばら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つねられた。
examples.english: I was pinched in the side.

examples.english: The car was hit in the side.

examples.english: A tunnel has been dug into the side of the mountain.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (side) + ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧/{腹|ばら} (belly/abdomen). The reading uses rendaku ({腹|ばら}). Most commonly heard in the context of side stitches during running.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横腹|よこばら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: my side hurts
- {横腹|よこばら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧: to hold one's side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脇腹|わきばら}→脇腹：14005_wakibara⟧: side of the abdomen (very close synonym, slightly more common)
- ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧: side (general)
- ⟦{側面|そくめん}→側面：05779_sokumen⟧: side surface (more formal/technical)
